```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(rfPermute)

library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}

feats_with_classes <- read_excel("C:/Users/priya/Downloads/Ty_superset_metabolites.xlsx")
```

```{r}
write.csv(feats_with_classes, file = "all_feat_classes.cv")
```

```{r}

num_df_final_id <- oculina_final[, c(6, 40:16396)]
  
```

```{r}
```

```{r}
Oculina_long <- num_df_final_id |>
  pivot_longer(-id,
               names_to = "Metabolite",
               values_to = "Abundance")
```

```{r}
Oculina_joined <- Oculina_long %>%
  left_join(feats_with_classes %>%
              select(metabolite, compound_class),
            by = c("Metabolite" = "metabolite"))
```

```{r}
Oculina_class <- Oculina_joined %>%
  group_by(id, compound_class) %>%
  summarise(Total_Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
Oculina_class_wide <- Oculina_class %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compound_class,
              values_from = Total_Abundance,
              values_fill = 0)
```

```{r}
superset_feats_annotated <-
  feats_with_classes |>
  filter(coraldb_compound_name != 'NA')
```

```{r}
Ocu_joined_anno <- Oculina_long %>%
  right_join(superset_feats_annotated %>%
              select(metabolite, compound_class, coraldb_compound_name, origin),
            by = c("Metabolite" = "metabolite"))
```

```{r}
Ocu_wide_anno <- Ocu_joined_anno %>%
  pivot_wider(-c(compound_class, coraldb_compound_name, origin),
              names_from = Metabolite,
              values_from = Abundance) 
```
